description: rebaseWhen is 'auto', not the preset's 'behind-base-branch': this repo has a merge queue, so a PR need not be up to date to enqueue, and forced rebases would re-run the full matrix on every open PR each time main moves.

packageRules.description: phpunit 12+ requires PHP >=8.3 and 13 requires >=8.4.1; this library supports ^8.2. Lift when the minimum PHP is raised.
Composer dev dependencies (require-dev) get the preset's devDependencies major policy: they merge after a 7 day soak.
